WAYS TO WIN

wilds.name: FLAMES OF FORTUNE BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Activate this Epic bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game maintains the mechanics of the WICKED WAYS bonus while offering an even greater chance of landing Wild symbols. In addition, each spin guarantees that one Divine Prayer Hand symbol lands!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 In the bonus games, FS symbols can only land on reels 1, 3 and 5. Only one FS symbol can land per reel.

scatters.name: WICKED WAYS BONUS
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game maintains the base game's mechanics with an increased chance of landing both types of Prayer Hand symbols as well as Wilds.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

scatters.name: LIVING ON A PRAYER BONUS
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game maintains the mechanics of the WICKED WAYS bonus. Throughout this bonus, there is an increased chance of landing Divine Prayer Hand symbols! Prayer Hands do not appear in this bonus.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

multipliers.name: WHEEL OF SIN
multipliers.behavior:
The Wheel of Sin is positioned outside the grid. Once activated, each section of the wheel will reveal either an Adding or Multiplying value.

 The three sections of the Wheel can have the following multiplier values:

 First section, Adding Multipliers: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x, 333x

 Second section, Adding Multipliers: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x, 333x or Multiplying Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20, x33

 Third section, Multiplying Multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20, x33

 Activate the Wheel of Sin by landing Prayer Hand or Divine Prayer Hand symbols on the grid during a win. A landed Prayer Hand symbol will reveal a number between 1- 3 which indicates how many sections on the Wheel of Sin will activate. Activated Prayer Hand symbols are removed from the grid, along with other winning symbols. As new symbols drop in, a new Prayer Hand may appear. Only one Prayer Hand symbol can appear on the grid at the same time.

 A landed Divine Prayer Hand symbol will always activate all three sections of the Wheel of Sin.

 If more than one multiplier is active on the Wheel of Sin, the multiplier values will first be combined one by one from left to right. The resulting value is then multiplied by the Total Win Bar amount to form the final payout.
